messages.body_plain:
I've been doing a bit of debugging lately, so I'll share some tips for doing that as well as writing R code that is easier to debug.  I'm especially looking at scripts which will run for a long time.

We are still looking for topics for future meetings.

    --Russell

messages.subject: [Epls-r-users] R Group in the Fall
messages.body_plain:
I have a dentist appointment tomorrow and a faculty meeting next week.

After discussion with Anita, (who was going to talk about her experience in the NAEP workshop), I've decided to take the rest of the summer off.

I'll be back in a week or so with a new poll about good times for R group in the Fall.

    --Russell
